last.summary: Resolved the merge conflict in projects/bzip2/spec/Bzip2/Spec.lean by taking origin/master's version (it no longer imports parts; the old import of Bzip2.Spec.Rle1 was dropped as master's design says). Then fixed what verify.sh reported on Rle1.lean: three lines over 100 chars, defs declared in Bzip2.Spec instead of Bzip2.Spec.Rle1 (merged into one namespace Bzip2.Spec.Rle1, as checks/spec/rle1.lean expects), missing doc strings on structure fields. Also corrected a citation: the 255-run cut in ADD_CHAR_TO_BLOCK is bzlib.c:275-276 (was 274, which is a comment line); re-read the other cites (557, 560, 633-660, 216-257, decompress.c:497) against the source. Result: `sh -c 'projects/bzip2/tools/verify.sh && projects/bzip2/tools/check-task.sh spec/rle1'` exits 0 ('verify: ok', 'check-task: spec/rle1: ok'). git status clean; git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD shows only projects/bzip2/spec/Bzip2/Spec/Rle1.lean (165 insertions).
